title: Tech firms rise after record Anthropic IPO but Nvidia casts shadow
summary: Tech firms mostly rose Thursday following a record IPO from Claude-creator Anthropic, but trading was cautious as investors deal with the fallout from the crisis engulfing AI titan Nvidia."Anthropic's IPO is a big near-term win for the tech sector and should help restore some investor confidence that the AI Revolution growth thesis is not waning," Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co said in a note, adding that Nvidia's troubles had cast a shadow over the sector.
